ai.summary: Anthropic urged California Governor Gavin Newsom to let officials seek court orders blocking AI models judged to pose a serious public risk. The company also argued that model-wide “kill switches” could create false reassurance, favoring more targeted interventions.
ai.title: Anthropic tells California governor courts should be able to block risky AI models

ai.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, highlighting long-running coding and cybersecurity capabilities and benchmark results it says put the model at the top of a leading AI index. Initial access is limited to selected cybersecurity defenders, with wider availability planned later.
ai.title: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon promises 'significant leap' in AI coding and cybersecurity

ai.summary: New York enacted a law restricting certain chatbot behaviors toward minors, including deceptive claims of being human and content promoting self-harm. The measure is part of a broader push by states to regulate AI services.
ai.title: New York enacts ban on 'unsafe' chatbot behavior with kids as states push AI regulation boundaries

ai.summary: OpenAI is reportedly planning to buy Google’s TPU chips as well as use Nvidia hardware, a development that would diversify its computing infrastructure. The available report does not provide further confirmed deal terms.
ai.title: OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google’s TPU chips alongside Nvidia

ai.summary: Microsoft reported $33.2 billion in Azure revenue and about $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI, as part of a record $92.3 billion quarter. The figures underscore the scale of the cloud provider’s AI-related business.
ai.title: Microsoft reports Azure at $33.2B and $10B in OpenAI revenue

quantum.summary: IBM researchers linked two 120-qubit processors with superconducting interconnects and reported 99% average fidelity for relay-based state transfer. Cross-chip CZ gates reached 94.75% average fidelity, highlighting progress toward modular scaling but also a gap to high-fidelity on-chip operations.
quantum.title: IBM Connects Two 120-Qubit Processors With 99% State-Transfer Fidelity

quantum.summary: IQM reported preparing a GHZ entangled state across all 54 qubits of its cloud-accessible Emerald processor, with reported fidelity of 0.516 after readout error mitigation. The result demonstrates full-chip entanglement, though it is a benchmark rather than evidence of a practical fault-tolerant computation.
quantum.title: IQM Demonstrates Entanglement Across a Complete 54-Qubit Processor

quantum.summary: Researchers from Jülich, Aachen and Cologne reported single-qubit operations lasting 6.8 nanoseconds with measured accuracies above 99.98% on an isolated superconducting transmon. Their R2D pulse-shaping method reduced unwanted multiphoton transitions by more than 20-fold versus DRAG, but performance on larger processors and two-qubit gates remains untested.
quantum.title: Researchers Curb Unwanted Transitions in Ultrafast Quantum Gates

quantum.summary: Nord Quantique announced a US$10 million extension to its DARPA Quantum Benchmarking Initiative Stage B agreement. The funding supports evaluation of its bosonic quantum-error-correction architecture, which aims to reduce the hardware overhead needed for fault-tolerant computing.
quantum.title: Nord Quantique Secures $10 Million DARPA Funding Extension

quantum.summary: E.ON, Qoro and the UK National Quantum Computing Centre demonstrated a hybrid quantum-classical approach to energy scheduling, dividing larger optimization workloads into subproblems of up to 50 qubits on IBM hardware. The team reported roughly threefold lower quantum execution time; the work is a proof of concept, not a deployment on a live power grid.
quantum.title: E.ON and Qoro Test Hybrid Quantum Computing for Energy Scheduling

quantum.summary: NVision reported a peer-reviewed Nature result demonstrating an individually addressable organic molecular spin-photon interface, a potential building block for connecting stationary qubits with photons. The company also announced a partnership with HyperLight to explore integrating the molecular qubits with photonic chips; integrated-chip demonstrations are still planned.
quantum.title: NVision Unveils First Manufacturable Molecular Qubit, Breakthrough Validated in Peer-Reviewed Nature Paper
